overview: The City Council ordained a new Vacant Building Ordinance and addressed several labor disputes involving Tufts University workers. The Council also partially funded the Law Department for one month while demanding a comprehensive accounting of city legal expenditures and an update on the search for a permanent City Solicitor.

items.title: West Medford Train Station Safety and Remembrance
items.summary: Approved a resolution in remembrance of John Westwater and called on the MBTA and Amtrak to make safety improvements at the West Medford station to prevent further pedestrian accidents.

items.title: Committee Records and Routine Reports
items.summary: Approved meeting records from June and July and committee reports concerning the tree ordinance and Fourth Amendment regulations regarding ICE officers.

items.title: Noise Ordinance Update
items.summary: Referred a resolution to update the city's 1974 noise ordinance to the Resident Services and Public Engagement Committee to modernize language and enforcement capability.

items.title: State Primary Election Administration
items.summary: Approved the temporary relocation of the Ward 4 Precinct 2 polling place to the Tufts Gancher Center and issued the call and warrant for the September 1st, 2026 state primary.

items.title: Neighborhood Ward Meeting Schedule
items.summary: Referred the proposed schedule for fall 2026 neighborhood ward meetings back to committee for further refinement of communication and recording logistics.

items.title: Tufts University Labor Relations
items.summary: Passed resolutions demanding that Tufts University reinstate a graduate worker allegedly facing retaliation and supporting facilities workers in their bargaining for a fair contract.

items.title: Police Chief Search Appropriation
items.summary: Tabled a $35,000 appropriation for a police chief search firm until state legislation regarding the hiring process is finalized and the Council receives written details on their role in the search.

items.title: Board and Commission Appointments
items.summary: Approved reappointments and new appointments to the Zoning Board of Appeals, Water and Sewer Commission, and the Medford Arts Council.

items.title: Community Preservation Committee Appropriations
items.summary: Approved $32,000 for a digital baseball scoreboard at Playstead Park and $10,000 for gutter and window restoration at the Osgoode House.

items.title: Municipal Finance and Prior Year Bills
items.summary: Approved a $1,500 payment for an unpaid permitting platform bill from the previous fiscal year.

items.title: Law Department Funding and Litigation Transparency
items.summary: Approved a reduced supplemental appropriation of $42,507.63 to provide one month of Law Department funding while demanding a categorized report on all city legal costs since 2020 and a status update on hiring a City Solicitor.

items.title: Vacant Building Ordinance and Personnel Amendments
items.summary: Ordained the Vacant Building Ordinance with amendments to vacancy thresholds and registration fees, alongside personnel changes for Health and Human Services and updates to the Commission for Persons with Disabilities.
